channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Japan food manufacturers boost U.S. investments as demand for Japanese cuisine grows
item.description: Japanese direct investment in U.S. food manufacturing stood at $8.19 billion as of the end of 2025, about 2.5 times the level seen a decade ago.

item.title: Deadly impacts of Typhoon Dujuan highlight toll of repeated rain disasters
item.description: Some residents are struggling to deal with flooding for the second time in weeks, after heavy rain that caused damage and disruption just last month.

item.title: Tokyo considers littering fine to tackle growing trash issue in popular areas
item.description: A rising volume of litter amid higher foot traffic has become a prominent concern for residents.

item.title: Japan’s gender gap isn’t where the rankings say it is
item.description: The telling number is what happens to a 29-year-old woman after her first child — and whether the door is still open when she is ready to return.

item.title: Rapper faces first big test as prime minister after Nepal flood disaster
item.description: The disaster has caused climate diplomacy to overshadow Balendra Shah's anti-corruption agenda that helped his rise to office.

item.title: SoftBank takes on junk-bond debt at record yields to fund OpenAI ambitions
item.description: The yields SoftBank has committed to pay are its highest-ever for dollar bonds on a day when benchmark U.S. Treasury rates soared to two-decade highs.

item.title: Tokyo used condo prices fall after 28 months as declines in central wards spread
item.description: Mortgage costs are climbing as the Bank of Japan raises interest rates and signals its willingness to tighten credit further, damping demand.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.

item.title: Four dead after powerful Typhoon Dujuan lashes Japan
item.description: The storm pulled away from Japan after bringing heavy rains and strong winds to Tokyo and surrounding areas.
